description: A small public demonstration collection modelled on a conservation digitisation workflow. It records provenance and preservation information alongside independently addressable folio files.
rights: Demonstration metadata and transcriptions: CC BY 4.0. No claim is made over the underlying cultural materials.

preservation.storageModel: Swarm postage batch with renewable duration
preservation.publicRecovery: Feed owner and topic resolve the current collection manifest without publisher credentials.
preservation.integrity: Each folio is separately content-addressed; its reference changes if its bytes change.

curatorialNote: This repository intentionally uses harmless sample text rather than photographs of protected manuscripts.
